title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War
provenance: DXMT changelog v0.80 (github.com/3Shain/dxmt/releases). udance4ever (highball-db#1287, 2026-11-17), Apple M1, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.28, engine x64-crossover26.3-r32, DXMT by the report (the environment's mode is D3DMetal), rated 4 of 5 after 5 minutes: the engine first given as x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r31 and crossed out for x64-crossover26.3-r32. The prologue drew with no graphical issues, and the game's benchmark averaged 63 fps on its auto settings with some texture flickering in the landscape. On the Wine 10 engine D3DMetal gave a black screen, and DualSense and XInput pads didn't work with Steam Input on or off, which the Wine 11 engine fixed. With the Metal HUD on, DXVK async on and AVX advertised. udance4ever again (highball-db#1287, 2026-11-17): with the Wine 11 environment's graphics mode back on Automatic, the page's DXMT applied by itself and the game worked.
notes: DXMT's changelog v0.80 lists an infinite hang on launch as fixed. Reported playable on a base M1 with DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r32 over 5 minutes: the prologue drew with no graphical issues, and the game's benchmark averaged 63 fps on its auto settings, with some texture flickering in the landscape (highball-db#1287). On the Wine 10 engine D3DMetal gave a black screen and controllers didn't work.

knownIssues.symptom: Some texture flickering in the landscape during the game's benchmark (M1, DXMT, Wine 11 r32, highball-db#1287)
A black screen on D3DMetal (M1, Wine 10 r31, highball-db#1287)
knownIssues.fix: use DXMT, the mode this page sets

knownIssues.symptom: DualSense and XInput pads don't work, with Steam Input on or off (M1, Wine 10 r31, highball-db#1287)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine (r32 in the report), where they worked
